newsitem.title: USA: Shuffle Master sees Q2 EPS at high end of range.
newsitem.headline: Shuffle Master sees Q2 EPS at high end of range.

text.p: Shuffle Master Inc said Monday it expects its earnings for the second quarter ending April 30 will be at the high end of the range of current consensus estimates.
A Shuffle Master spokesman said the range of second quarter estimates is $0.09 to $0.11 a share, down from $0.14 a year ago when it had a significantly lower tax rate.
The tax rate this year is about 36 percent, down from last year's rate of about 23 percent.
Shuffle Master also said that its board of directors authorized an additional $5 million for share repurchase.
The company said that, through last week, about 570,000 shares had been repurchased, fully utilizing the $5 million originally authorized.

"Given that we expect earnings for our second fiscal quarter, ending April 30, to be at the high end of current consensus estimates and our belief that the company fundamentals have never been better, we perceive this to be an extraordinary buying opportunity," Joseph Lahti, president, said in a statement.
Shuffle Master supplies shuffler systems, proprietary table games and video games to the casino and gaming industry.
